LESSON: BELIEF IN ALLAH

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PILLARS
Topic 2.1: Belief in Allah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Belief in Allah. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Belief in Allah.
2. Explain Belief in Allah to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in Allah.
4. Show that you can: identify oneself as a creation Allah’s Creation Myself Creator) (Suggested time: 4 lessons) discussion about themselves recite poems related to the strand games/hands-on activities related to the strand discussion on good and bad touches activities such as painting oneself and printing hand and foot
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in Allah. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Belief in Allah important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
